title: GRWM: flamingo edition

scenes.headline: Get ready with me: flamingo edition
Skip the makeup. Eat the shrimp.
Eat with your head upside down. It's a whole look.
Flamingos are pink because of what they eat
scenes.body: Algae and brine shrimp carry carotenoid pigments. A flamingo's body metabolises them, turning its feathers pink.

caption:
This glow is 100% dietary.

Flamingos are filter feeders: they sieve algae, small seeds, tiny crustaceans and fly larvae out of shallow water.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Spoofs the get-ready-with-me beauty influencer format with wild flamingo photos and a Camargue courtship-display clip; each 'beauty step' is a true feeding or display behaviour.
